SPY.text: SPY rose about 0.2% as strong earnings from Boeing and Coca-Cola plus lower oil prices outweighed a 4.5% semiconductor-sector drop and broader concerns about returns on AI spending.

QQQ.text: QQQ fell about 1.0% as the semiconductor and AI selloff deepened on concerns about heavy data-center spending, profitability and rising Chinese competition ahead of Big Tech earnings.
